# Vendor icon terms

These four SVGs are an unmodified snapshot of [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) 16.0.0, retrieved 2026-10-10. The Simple Icons project is released under [CC0 1.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/16.0.0/LICENSE.md). Read the [Simple Icons disclaimer](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/16.0.0/DISCLAIMER.md). These four titles have no license field in that release's icon data. The marks remain trademarks of F5, Palo Alto Networks, NGINX, and Datadog.

Use each mark only to identify that product on an architecture diagram:

| File | Product | Brand fill |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `f5.svg` | F5 | `#E4002B` |
| `paloaltonetworks.svg` | Palo Alto Networks | `#F04E23` |
| `nginx.svg` | NGINX | `#009639` |
| `datadog.svg` | Datadog | `#632CA6` |

Keep the path artwork as stored. The brand fill is applied only when a diagram embeds the icon, from the hex in `manifest.json`. Do not crop, flip, or rotate the artwork. Do not use a mark for a different product, or as a product logo, app icon, or general-purpose icon pack. This is the maintainers' reading of those terms, not legal advice.
